turnstileAndMail: All config, widget script/iframe and POST responses are local intercepted fixtures. No real CAPTCHA, credentials, queue or email delivery was exercised.
accessibilityScope: Native Chromium accessibility names/tree, labels, keyboard and status attributes; not a standalone screen-reader session.
captureMethod: Native section clip at the tested width, temporarily increasing viewport height to include the loaded cross-origin fixture iframe. No DOM or product style changes/masks; original viewport restored after capture.

sdkLoadRegression.note: The loader completes from the script load event after checking the render API. The fixture now throws the actual SDK async/defer-ready incompatibility message, so the old loader cannot pass this suite.

notes: All eight 320/390/768/1440 light/dark form layouts and five acceptance/pending/error/unavailable/no-JavaScript states were inspected. Fields, labels, buttons and email fallback remain readable without horizontal overflow.
The inherited system font, blue accent, square borders and support page grid are preserved.

The visible CAPTCHA frame is explicitly labelled as a local test; it is not proof of an actual Turnstile challenge. Native captures temporarily extend viewport height at the tested width so the loaded cross-origin fixture pixels are painted, with no DOM/style masks.
Technical fields are blank by default and optional; test names/tree and keyboard checks cover browser accessibility behavior, not an actual screen-reader session.
